description: Create a checkout session (UCP checkout). Nothing is charged; the response lists totals, missing buyer inputs and payment handlers. Shipping address in checkout.fulfillment.methods[0].destinations[0] (address_country decides price and currency), email in checkout.buyer.email. Custom-made items: line_items[].custom_inputs = {vehicle:{make,model,year}, measurements:{opening}}. Limits: at most 3 per line item and 5 items per checkout (otherwise quantity_limit_exceeded, nothing is created).
name: create_checkout
title: Create checkout
